name: Maruti Suzuki
narrative: Management targeted over 10% sales volume growth and ₹14,000 crore capex for FY27. In Q2 FY27, revenue expanded 26.0% year-on-year to ₹53,356 crore, but net profit dropped 26.4% to ₹2,466 crore with an EBITDA margin of 9.0%.

promises.statement: The company expects to add 500,000 units of annual production capacity in FY27.

said.quote: The second plant at the Kharkhoda facility and the fourth production line at the Hansalpur facility in Gujarat is set to become operational within this financial year. Each of these new units will add an annual production capacity of 250,000 vehicles

promises.statement: Expects sales volume growth of over 10% in FY27.

said.quote: The broad expectation, which our Chairman also conveyed, is growth of over 10% this year as compared to the last year

promises.statement: Targeting INR 14,000 crores capex for FY27.

said.quote: Overall, on the capex for FY 26-27, we are looking at a INR14,000 crores capex for the full year
